schema.name: run_id
schema.description: The sweep that evaluated this trajectory; also the retry cleanup key.

schema.name: agent_name
schema.description: Observed agent. Every read filters on it.

schema.name: trajectory_id
schema.description: The conversation this row is about: a session id where the sweep judged a whole session, an invocation/trace id where it judged one turn. The same value the findings and their occurrences carry.

schema.name: created_at
schema.description: When the sweep recorded it. Partition column.

schema.name: source
schema.description: Telemetry source the trajectory was ingested from: big_query, cloud_ops or cloud_logging.

schema.name: source_session_id
schema.description: Session a single-turn trajectory belongs to, so a reader can walk from one turn to the conversation around it.

schema.name: source_trace_ids
schema.description: Cloud Trace ids this trajectory is made of, in chronological order -- one per turn for a whole session, one in total for a single turn. The first is the conversation's opening turn, which is what a console link uses. Empty for big_query, which carries no trace ids.

schema.name: ingest_status
schema.description: What ingestion made of it: ingested (assembled whole), partial (built from incomplete telemetry, so weaker as evidence), or not_ingested (sampled but unusable -- unparseable telemetry, or no conversation content). The last is what explains a sample smaller than the run's budget.

schema.name: sampling_weight
schema.description: Weight weighted sampling gave the trajectory: 1 plus what its risk signals added. Null under uniform sampling.

schema.name: inclusion_probability
schema.description: Probability that the sweep picked the trajectory, given the rest of its sample. A figure for all traffic counts the trajectory as 1 / inclusion_probability trajectories. Null on rows without sampling recorded.

schema.name: sampling_signals
schema.description: The risk properties behind sampling_weight, each relative to the sweep's window. Null under uniform sampling.

fields.name: has_abnormal_finish
fields.description: A model call stopped for a reason other than a normal stop.

fields.name: has_tool_reported_error
fields.description: A tool returned a result that reports a failure. Never set on cloud_logging, which records no tool calls.

fields.name: busy_turn_calls
fields.description: The most calls to one tool in one turn (on Cloud Logging, model calls). Null without any call.

fields.name: total_tokens
fields.description: The trajectory's total tokens. Null when no model call recorded its usage.

fields.name: slowest_turn_ms
fields.description: Duration of the trajectory's slowest turn, in milliseconds.

fields.name: busy_turn_percentile
fields.description: Percentile, 0 to 1, of busy_turn_calls among the window's trajectories. Null where busy_turn_calls is.

fields.name: cost_percentile
fields.description: Percentile, 0 to 1, of total_tokens among the window's trajectories. Null where total_tokens is.

fields.name: latency_percentile
fields.description: Percentile, 0 to 1, of slowest_turn_ms among the window's trajectories. Null where slowest_turn_ms is.

fields.name: busy_turn_tail
fields.description: Tail score, 0 to 1, of busy_turn_percentile under the cutoff the sweep ran with.

fields.name: cost_tail
fields.description: Tail score, 0 to 1, of cost_percentile under the cutoff the sweep ran with.

fields.name: latency_tail
fields.description: Tail score, 0 to 1, of latency_percentile under the cutoff the sweep ran with.
